correctness.rationale: The source update reduces exactly to a scalar/table linear recursion. Direct second-moment expansion gives the symbolic four-moment matrix. Its determinant factorization, the cone Perron invariant reduction and perturbation/real-root continuation establish the exact spectral threshold. A two-step reachable-set spanning argument ensures that the prescribed nonzero-solution initialization has nonzero projection on every positive dual Perron eigendirection, including the critical case. The finite 354-check script corroborates symbolic identities and finite examples but does not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: For each m this is the natural identical-row maximally coherent stress test of a new residual-tracking Kaczmarz method. The exact full-state and prescribed-initialization cutoff is not merely a one-step norm bound; its ratio to the published conservative sufficient choice grows as m+4. It supplies a sharp reference criterion for tuning and interpreting variance-reduced row algorithms, without claiming general matrix optimality.
